title: 我的爱好
content: 我有很多爱好。我喜欢运动，因为运动对身体好。每个星期天，我和朋友去打篮球，也去跑步。虽然很累，但是我很快乐。晚上我在家听歌，看书。
content_pinyin: wǒ yǒu hěn duō ài hào 。 wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng ， yīn wèi yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ hǎo 。 měi gè xīng qī tiān ， wǒ hé péng you qù dǎ lán qiú ， yě qù pǎo bù 。 suī rán hěn lèi ， dàn shì wǒ hěn kuài lè 。 wǎn shang wǒ zài jiā tīng gē ， kàn shū 。
translation: I have many hobbies. I like sports, because sports are good for the body. Every Sunday, my friends and I go play basketball and also go running. Although it is tiring, I am happy. In the evening I listen to songs and read at home.

title: 坐地铁
content: 今天我要去机场。我坐公交车到车站，再坐地铁。地铁很快，人也很多。从我家到机场要一个小时。我已经买好了机票，准备去外国旅游。
content_pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ yào qù jī chǎng 。 wǒ zuò gōng jiāo chē dào chē zhàn ， zài zuò dì tiě 。 dì tiě hěn kuài ， rén yě hěn duō 。 cóng wǒ jiā dào jī chǎng yào yī gè xiǎo shí 。 wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le jī piào ， zhǔn bèi qù wài guó lǚ yóu 。
translation: Today I am going to the airport. I take the bus to the station, then take the subway. The subway is fast, and there are many people too. It takes one hour from my home to the airport. I have already bought my plane ticket and am getting ready to travel abroad.

title: 我的生日
content: 昨天是我的生日。朋友们都来我家。妈妈做了很多菜，很好吃。大家一起唱歌、跳舞，很高兴。我今年已经十八岁了。这个生日我很快乐。
content_pinyin: zuó tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì 。 péng you men dōu lái wǒ jiā 。 mā ma zuò le hěn duō cài ， hěn hǎo chī 。 dà jiā yì qǐ chàng gē 、 tiào wǔ ， hěn gāo xìng 。 wǒ jīn nián yǐ jīng shí bā suì le 。 zhè ge shēng rì wǒ hěn kuài lè 。
translation: Yesterday was my birthday. My friends all came to my home. Mom made many dishes, very delicious. Everyone sang and danced together, very happy. I am already eighteen years old this year. I was very happy on this birthday.

title: 学汉语
content: 我在大学学习汉语。老师很好，上课的时候教我们说话、写字。开始的时候我不懂，但是现在好多了。我每天学新词。汉语很有意思，我很喜欢学。
content_pinyin: wǒ zài dà xué xué xí Hàn yǔ 。 lǎo shī hěn hǎo ， shàng kè de shí hou jiāo wǒ men shuō huà 、 xiě zì 。 kāi shǐ de shí hou wǒ bù dǒng ， dàn shì xiàn zài hǎo duō le 。 wǒ měi tiān xué xīn cí 。 Hàn yǔ hěn yǒu yì si ， wǒ hěn xǐ huan xué 。
translation: I study Chinese at university. The teacher is very good; in class she teaches us to speak and write characters. At the beginning I did not understand, but now it is much better. I learn new words every day. Chinese is very interesting, and I like learning it.

title: 买衣服
content: 星期天我和妈妈去商场买衣服。商场里的衣服颜色很多，有红色的、白色的、黑色的。我想买一条裤子，但是太长了。后来我买了一件白色的衣服，很漂亮。
content_pinyin: xīng qī tiān wǒ hé mā ma qù shāng chǎng mǎi yī fu 。 shāng chǎng lǐ de yī fu yán sè hěn duō ， yǒu hóng sè de 、 bái sè de 、 hēi sè de 。 wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tiáo kù zi ， dàn shì tài cháng le 。 hòu lái wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn bái sè de yī fu ， hěn piào liang 。
translation: On Sunday mom and I go to the mall to buy clothes. The clothes in the mall come in many colors: red, white, black. I want to buy a pair of trousers, but they are too long. Later I bought a white piece of clothing, very pretty.

title: 我的一天
content: 我每天七点起床。我洗手，再吃早饭。八点我走路去学校。中午我和同学一起吃饭。下午四点我回家。晚上我看一会儿电视，就去睡觉。
content_pinyin: wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn qǐ chuáng 。 wǒ xǐ shǒu ， zài chī zǎo fàn 。 bā diǎn wǒ zǒu lù qù xué xiào 。 zhōng wǔ wǒ hé tóng xué yì qǐ chī fàn 。 xià wǔ sì diǎn wǒ huí jiā 。 wǎn shang wǒ kàn yí huì r diàn shì ， jiù qù shuì jiào 。
translation: I get up at seven every day. I wash my hands, then eat breakfast. At eight I walk to school. At noon I eat with my classmates. At four in the afternoon I go home. In the evening I watch TV for a while, then go to sleep.
